name: guideline_rag_tool
description: Evidence-grounded answer to a clinical question, retrieved from a guideline/literature corpus with inline [REF#] citations and an optional faithfulness check.

help.summary: Ask a clinical question; get a cited, guideline-grounded answer (local Qwen3-8B).

options.name: min_score
options.description: Minimum cosine similarity to keep a passage (default 0.2)

options.name: source_context
options.description: Optional extra context from an uploaded note/FHIR source
